attributes.title: 2027 ENT for the PA-C
attributes.series: ENT for the PA-C Annual CME Conference
attributes.organizer: Society of Physician Assistants in Otorhinolaryngology/Head & Neck Surgery
attributes.summary:
SPAO-HNS, the society for PAs in otolaryngology and head and neck surgery, holds ENT for the PA-C in New Orleans from March 31 to April 4, 2027: two optional hands-on workshop days followed by three lecture days. The venue is not named yet.

The society will submit the program for AAPA Category 1 CME; the number of credits is not published. Early-bird registration through January 24, 2027 is $825 for members and $925 for nonmembers, then $1,000 and $1,100. Students pay $525 and each workshop costs $175 early or $195 later. Registrations after March 14, 2027 carry a $100 fee.

SPAO-HNS notes that NPs can often claim AAPA credit but should check with their certifying body.
